title: Caprese Chicken Bake
shortDescription: Baked chicken breasts with tomato, mozzarella, and balsamic glaze
subtitle: Baked chicken breasts with tomato, mozzarella, and balsamic glaze
description: Chicken breasts bake with grape tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil, finished with balsamic reduction for a colorful hall tray.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Caprese Chicken Bake in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch chicken. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Reduce balsamic
steps.instruction: Simmer balsamic vinegar in a small pot 10–12 minutes until reduced by half and coats a spoon with syrupy consistency, not thin and runny. Maintain a steady simmer — bubbles should break the surface without a rolling boil that shreds delicate proteins. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Season chicken and tomatoes
steps.instruction: Rub chicken with olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Arrange on two half-sheets with halved tomatoes tucked around edges. Plan about 8 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Bake chicken through
steps.instruction: Bake at 400°F 16–18 minutes until chicken reads 165°F and tomatoes begin to burst and release juice into the pan. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Add mozzarella
steps.instruction: Top each breast with mozzarella slices. Return to oven 6–8 minutes until cheese melts with light golden spots, not rubbery and stiff. Bake until the center reaches a safe internal temp (165°F) and edges look set — use a thermometer at the thickest point. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Finish with basil and balsamic
steps.instruction: Scatter basil over tray. Drizzle balsamic reduction at the line. Chicken should slice cleanly with juices running clear. Plan about 3 minutes for this step at crew scale. Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a call — never serve picked-over pans to late crew. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

proTips: Use ciliegine mozzarella for faster, even melting.
Serve over arugula for a one-plate meal without extra cooking.
Store balsamic reduction in squeeze bottle for consistent drizzle.
tonightSpread: Whole-wheat pasta with olive oil and garlic.
leftovers: Slice into caprese chicken sandwiches on ciabatta.
Chop over a grain bowl with extra balsamic.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Looks impressive with almost no skill required. Bright flavors after weeks of heavy comfort food.
mealPrepNotes: Pound chicken to even thickness for uniform baking. Reduce balsamic while chicken roasts. Station: Pound breasts to ¾-inch even thickness—thick spots dry before thin spots finish. Station: Add mozzarella last 8 minutes so it melts without rubberizing. Station: Drizzle balsamic at the line, not before hold—reduction stays glossy.
